title: Design System: Modern education digital portfolio

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Exact brand green with accessible dark ink.

extensions.scope: Public portfolio and owner interface; document templates preserved

about.content: Existing saved/default content and routes retained

homeTitle.display: white alpha title above teacher name
homeTitle.scope: Home cover only; no manuscript fonts or page theme

referenceHomeCover.composition: Full-width navy banner; right title/name/actions; left floating teacher card; four desktop KPI cards
referenceHomeCover.mobile: Stacked cover, then two-column KPI grid
referenceHomeCover.scope: Home only; preserve actual records and actions

criterionGrid.reference: Owner-pinned navy two-column criterion card screenshot
criterionGrid.composition: Two RTL columns above 900px; one below. Right round meaningful icon, small official number/title/badge, left report-count action, bottom documentation track.
criterionGrid.tones: Fixed navy/green/sand by criterion ID; never dependent on report count
criterionGrid.navigation: Direct criterion page; no drawer and no search
criterionGrid.data: All 11 criteria sorted by ID; real public report counts. Completion unknown until a trusted aggregate and configured targets exist; never fabricate percentages.
criterionGrid.scope: Criterion grids on home and criteria index; navy header/background only on criteria index. Approved report documents unchanged.
criterionGrid.homeSurface: Transparent on the existing light home canvas; no navy panel or arabesque; dark readable filter labels and pale green active state. Standalone criteria index stays navy.

fullPortfolioPrint.palette: Navy #15445a, ministry green #07a869, sand #c1b489; white inside pages
fullPortfolioPrint.typography: Embedded self-hosted Tajawal, no network font dependency in the generated document
fullPortfolioPrint.structure: Main cover; dynamic contents; About cover and separate content sections; schedule cover/content; all 11 ordered criteria with reports/image previews; courses cover/complete chronological ledger
fullPortfolioPrint.pagination: Measured blocks; intact cards; word-boundary splits only for oversized prose; actual page numbers and totals
fullPortfolioPrint.data: Fresh public snapshot and public display documents only; no private originals/contact or database mutation
fullPortfolioPrint.output: Direct A4 PDF with clickable links and native print/selectable-text PDF; sequential 2x rendering
fullPortfolioPrint.scope: Header print action only; existing single-report and course exports unchanged

narrative.overview: White structured content, navy Arabic typography, ministry green and blue banner. Genuine existing logo assets, real record statistics, ordered performance criteria and accessible course search. Personal portfolio, no official endorsement.
narrative.motion: Native 280ms fade/slide entrances, 250ms control feedback, reduced-motion fallback; no forced scrolling.
narrative.accessibility: Dark ink on bright green; dark scrim over hero gradient, visible focus, native keyboard behavior.
narrative.data: No API, permissions or stored content changes. No invented completion percentages.
